09Chapter 9 · Wrapping Up: Tools to Help You Build, MCP Extensions, and Contributing to MCP

Tools to help you build — MCP Registry

MCP ka core seekhne ke baad ab un tools ki baari hai jo MCP servers aur clients ko build aur use karna aasan banate hain — khaas taur par MCP Registry, jo servers ko discover karne ka centralized tareeqa hai.

Build tools ka landscape

MCP ki popularity explode hone ke saath tools banaye gaye — aur banaye jaa rahe hain — jo MCP servers aur clients ko behtar build aur use karne me madad karte hain. Yeh aam taur par common problems solve karte hain, jo ya to MCP khud address nahi karta, ya MCP-powered agents ko deploy aur operate karna aasan aur zyada compliant banate hain. Kai third-party tools release hue hain, lekin woh asal me do broad areas ke aas-paas coalesce hue hain: governance (MCP servers ko deploy, maintain, authorize aur serve kaise karna hai) aur context management (context ko effectively kaise use karna hai, taaki token usage low rahe lekin response quality high rahe). In do broad areas ke landscape ko dekha gaya hai, aur specific tools me bhi dive kiya gaya hai, jaise server discovery improve karne ke liye MCP registry, zyada efficient tool calling ke liye Code Mode, behtar developer experience ke liye alternative MCP frameworks, aur testing tools.

MCP Registry — servers ko discover karna

MCP registry saare MCP servers ka ek programmable, centralized repository provide karne ki pehli koshish hai. Registry se pehle kisi given task ke liye use ho sakne wale MCP servers dhoondhne ke liye internet — aur aksar GitHub — khodna padta tha. MCP internally discoverability ke baare me hai, lekin use initially entire servers ki discovery enable karne ke liye nahi banaya gaya tha. Yeh ek problem ban gaya, kyunki community bani aur MCP servers ki exponentially badhti hui sankhya banane lagi: zyada tar ke paas sirf GitHub par ek repo tha, jisse humans aur agents ke liye perfect server dhoondhne ke liye noise me se chhanna mushkil ho jaata tha.

MCP registry ise solve karti hai, MCP servers ke baare me data ki ek browsable, centralized metaregistry ka kaam karke, jo MCP server code ya binaries ko reference karti hai, jo dusri package registries jaise PyPI ya npm me rehte hain. Is registry ka ek robust API bhi hai, taaki developers aasani se programmatically apna server registry ko submit kar sakein, aur agents registry data ko standardized format me aasani se pull aur browse kar sakein.

Lekin MCP server metadata ka repository hona hi is project ka sabse interesting aspect nahi hai. Servers submit karne aur registry par servers query karne ka API architecture ka ek useful hissa hai, lekin registry ke baare me asal me exciting cheez yeh hai ki ise zyada heavily curated subregistries ka source banne ke liye banaya gaya hai. Subregistry ek MCP registry hai, jo canonical registry se data consume karti hai aur MCP Registry OpenAPI specification implement karti hai, jisse maintainer ek web frontend bana sakta hai ya users programmatically registry se connect kar sakte hain. Vision yeh hai ki subregistries badi, trusted organizations jaise Anthropic aur GitHub ke saath-saath chhoti organizations, community groups aur community members ke dwara bhi host ki jayengi, aur woh un maintainers ki curation reflect karengi. OpenAPI spec me ek _meta field bhi hai, jahan maintainers apni additional metadata de sakte hain, jaise user comments, ratings, status labels, ya kuch bhi aur jo woh chahte hon. Subregistry maintainers sirf apni imagination se limited hain: ek internal subregistry aasani se imagine ki ja sakti hai, jo ek badi organization ke liye ho aur jisme sirf woh servers hon jinhe organization ki security team ne vet kiya ho.

MCP registry ecosystem ki architecture aisi hai: sabse upar official MCP registry hai. Yahan MCP server developers apne server ki metadata submit karte hain, jinme yeh bhi hota hai ki actual packaged code kahan rehta hai. Subregistries official MCP registry se aur dusri subregistries se data pull kar sakti hain, aur unke paas apni server entries bhi ho sakti hain — jaise un servers ke liye jo apni MCP registry wale enterprise ke liye internal hain. Subregistries official registry se pull kiye gaye data ko curate kar sakti hain, additional metadata aur annotations add kar sakti hain, aur zyada specific communities ko serve kar sakti hain. Uske downstream, users official registry ya kisi bhi subregistry se apni pasand ke tool se, wahi API use karke, pull kar sakte hain.

Official MCP registry me add ki jaane wali basic server metadata minimal hai, lekin itni flexible hai ki subregistries server listings ko annotate aur display karne me creative ho sakti hain. Basic fields me server ka naam, description, title, repository jahan server ka code host hai, aur packages ki list shamil hai, jo us package registry ki taraf point karte hain jahan server host hai, jaise npm ya PyPI. Poora schema MCP registry GitHub repository par available hai. Is specification me ek _meta field hai, jo publisher server metadata provide karne ke liye aur registry provider users ke liye registry-specific metadata add karne ke liye use kar sakta hai. Yahan subregistry apna specific data store karti hai, jaise server ke liye user ratings, jisse humans, traditional software aur agents ko woh saara data mil jaata hai jo ek given subregistry apni server listings enrich karne ke liye use karti hai.

Governance tools — sab kuch ek jagah

Enterprises ke liye MCP server banana aur use kahin host karna hi kaafi nahi hota. Kai organizations multiple servers ko ek unified authentication experience ke peeche deploy karna chah sakti hain, ya server proxying ke liye ek single API endpoint chah sakti hain, ya agents deploy karna aasan banana chah sakti hain. Yeh features (aur kai aur) all-in-one governance tools kehte hue tools aur platforms ki class offer karti hai. Yeh tools apne users ki needs jitne diverse hain, lekin common thread yeh hai ki woh providers ko MCP servers ko secure, deploy aur host karne ka tareeqa dete hain. Kuch truly all-in-one hain, jaise MintMCP, Arcade Cloud aur Prefect Horizon — deployment tooling, MCP gateways (organization ke saare MCP servers ke liye ek single, secure entrypoint), ready-to-use MCP subregistries, authentication, observability tooling, aur aksar agents ke liye bhi wahi tooling dete hain.

Kuch zyada focused hain. Cloudflare MCP portals Cloudflare users ke liye pure MCP server gateways hain, jo unhe multiple unsecured aur secured MCP servers ko ek single endpoint ke peeche rakhne dete hain. Uske aage, MCP portal administrators portal se manage kiye jaane wale servers ke pool se selectively tools provide kar sakte hain. Portal endpoints khud query parameters ke saath aate hain, jo portal ke andar servers ko call karne wale users ke liye options dete hain. minimize_tools option, for example, agents ko tool ki full definition on demand lene deta hai, up front ke bajay, aur search_and_execute connected host application ke liye available tools ki kul sankhya ko do par limit karta hai: tool definitions dhoondhne ke liye query, aur unhe call karne ke liye execute.

Kuch gateways bahut broad hain. IBM ka open source ContextForge ek aur all-in-one governance tool hai, lekin yeh abhi tak discuss kiye gaye tools se bahut wide net cast karta hai. Yeh ek gateway aur registry hai, jo MCP servers, A2A agents, aur plain REST aur gRPC APIs tak ko ek single governed endpoint ke peeche federate karta hai, discovery, OpenTelemetry-based observability, aur authorization aur configuration ke liye ek admin dashboard laata hai.

Anthropic ne ek related feature bhi release ki hai, jise MCP tunnels kaha jaata hai. Traditional tareeqe me, agar tum apni infrastructure par MCP server host kar rahe ho to apne network me ek inbound port kholna padta hai, taaki clients connection khol sakein, jisse ek naya attack surface banta hai. MCP tunnels ise flip kar dete hain: tumhare network ke andar ki ek service Anthropic-controlled edge proxy se connection establish karti hai, jisse tumhare servers use karne wale clients connect karenge aur khule hue session se communicate karenge. Yeh do components se hota hai: cloudflared, tunnel daemon jo outbound connection kholta hai, aur Anthropic ka proxy, jisse clients connect karenge jab tumhare MCP server se connection request karenge. MCP tunnels ka main advantage tumhare network ke inbound attack surface ko band karna hai, kyunki ab public internet ke liye port kholkar potentially malicious connections ko invite karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Tunnels requested connections ke liye IP validation bhi dete hain, aur tumhare aur tumhare client ke beech TLS encryption bhi dete hain, jisse Anthropic aur Cloudflare jaise providers ke liye clients aur tumhare servers ke beech traffic padhna roka jaata hai.

09.1Chapter 9 · Wrapping Up: Tools to Help You Build, MCP Extensions, and Contributing to MCP

Alternative frameworks aur Code Mode

Official MCP SDKs powerful hain, lekin kabhi-kabhi confusing bhi. Isi liye alternative frameworks aur Code Mode jaise tareeqe bane — behtar developer experience aur kam token usage ke liye.

Alternative MCP frameworks

MCP SDKs powerful hain, lekin kabhi-kabhi confusing bhi. Isse kuch organizations ne canonical SDKs ka istemal karke apne frameworks banana decide kiya, taaki apni design philosophy add karke developer experience improve kar sakein. Shuru me kai alternative frameworks ubhre, jo kuch official SDKs ki issues address karne ke liye the — jaise MCP spec ko poori tarah implement na karna ya slow development times. Yeh largely address kar diye gaye hain, isliye un projects me se kai abandon kar diye gaye hain. Lekin do major frameworks bache hain.

Prefect — Horizon ke creators — ne FastMCP bhi banaya hai. Currently v3 par hai, aur v1 ke kuch design choices itne useful the ki woh eventually MCP Python SDK me incorporate kar liye gaye aur Python me MCP servers banane ka standard tareeqa ban gaye (SDK ki class ka naam tab se MCPServer kar diya gaya hai, jabki Prefect ka FastMCP original naam rakhta hai). v3 me bhi servers banane ke patterns wahi rehte hain, to apne server logic ko FastMCP me move karna aam taur par sirf imports change karne ka kaam hota hai. Poora framework ab full protocol support ke saath clients banane aur MCP Apps ka support bhi include karta hai. FastMCP developer experience ke liye really shine karta hai, lekin major value add proxy servers, middleware, authentication aur dusri features ka support hai, jo servers ko productionize karne ka ek bada hissa hain.

Dusra major alternative framework hai Arcade ka arcade-mcp. Yeh sirf MCP servers banane par focus karta hai, FastMCP ya Python SDK jaise all-in-one framework hone ke bajay. Lekin arcade-mcp sirf MCP servers aur tools banana aasan nahi banata — yeh Arcade Cloud platform ke saath integrate karta hai, taaki deployment aur authorization simplified ho jaaye. Bonus ke roop me isme ek chhoti evaluation library bhi hai, jo server ki tool-calling accuracy ko kisi bhi LLM ke against test karne me madad karti hai, jiska access tumhare paas ho. Jab official SDK master kar lo aur production-ready server deploy karne ke liye taiyaar ho, to FastMCP aur arcade-mcp dono deployment headaches se bachne me madad kar sakte hain.

Code Mode — tools ko code me badalna

Apne MCP portals ko power dene ke liye Cloudflare ne Code Mode bhi develop kiya, jo kuch had tak code execution research se inspired hai. Code Mode ek tareeqa banaya gaya tha, jisse Cloudflare apne agents ke liye token use kam kar sake aur performance badha sake, jab uske agents tools se overloaded hote the. Code Mode me, ek ya zyada MCP servers se full tool schema ko agent ke context window me load karne ke bajay, Cloudflare ka agent SDK tool spec ko ek zyada compact TypeScript API me convert karta hai. Yeh phir LLM ko bheja jaata hai, taaki user ki request ke hisaab se woh uske against code likhe, aur woh code ek isolated sandbox me execute hota hai. Jab kisi tool ko call karna hota hai, to model se request karke aur client se har successive call ke liye server ko CallTool message bhejkar karne ke bajay, yeh sab ek baar me sandbox me generated code se ho jaata hai, jo server ko proper JSON-RPC messages emit karta hai. Sandbox dusre client ka kaam karta hai, credentials ke saath, jisse koi bhi credentials model ko expose nahi hote.

Iska ek aur form bhi available hai, jisme sandboxed code execution host application ke bajay MCP server ka hissa hota hai, jo MCP client hold karta hai. Cloudflare ka Code Mode MCP server is approach ko apne enormous API ko tame karne ke liye leta hai. Apne 2,500+ endpoints me se har ek ko individual tools ke roop me expose karne ke bajay, Cloudflare ne apne MCP server par sirf do tools expose karne ka faisla kiya: search() aur execute(). Agent JavaScript likhta hai, jo search() ko feed hota hai, taaki use chahiye hue endpoints dhoondhe — OpenAPI spec kabhi model ke context me enter nahi hoti, sirf results aate hain — phir agent execute() ke against JavaScript likhta hai, taaki authenticated calls kare, requests chain kare, aur ek hi run me pagination handle kare. Code server-side isolated worker me execute hota hai, jisme koi filesystem nahi hai, koi environment variables nahi hain, aur outbound network access band hai. Isse Cloudflare ko apne poore API tak pahunch lagbhag 1,000 tokens me mil jaati hai. Yeh portal mode search_and_execute jaisa hi hai; client-side Code Mode se farq sirf yeh hai ki sandbox kahan chalta hai aur API ke baare me kaun jaanta hai.

Toh yeh universally kyun use nahi hota? Iske kuch reasons hain. Pehla, Code Mode har call ke liye universal win nahi hai. Agar tumhare paas sirf chhoti sankhya me purpose-built tools hain, jinhe zyada training ki zaroorat nahi hai, to Code Mode se zyada win nahi dikhega. Dusra, agar tools ko intelligently chain karna hai, lekin us chain ki structure khud previous tool calls ke output ke meaning par depend karti hai, to Code Mode utna helpful nahi hoga. Iska kaaran yeh hai ki har tool ka output agle tool ka input banne ke bajay LLM ko jaana chahiye, jisse har tool call ke liye model tak round trip chahiye hoti hai, jo error compound karta hai aur responses slow karta hai. Isse security risks bhi ho sakte hain, kyunki untrusted tool output seedha model me wapas feed ho raha hai. Yahan ek pattern dikhta hai: Code Mode aur code execution dono ek single tool call me jitna zyada deterministic code ho sake, use shove karne ki koshish karte hain. Chapter 5 me tool design par baat karte waqt bhi yahi recommend kiya gaya tha: aise tools banao jo full behaviors encode karein, composable atoms of behavior ke bajay. Jab aise banate hain to ek single tool call me jitna zyada deterministic code ho sake, use shove kar rahe hote hain. Isse use hone wale tools ki sankhya, use hone wala context, aur model ke tool choice me confusion — sab kam hote hain.

Testing tools — Inspector aur MCPJam

Testing ke liye MCP Inspector se tum pehle se familiar ho — Chapters 5 aur 7 me use heavily use kiya gaya hai. MCP Inspector MCP servers ke liye ek visual debugger hai. Under the hood, iska matlab hai ki yeh ek fully featured MCP client hai, jo kisi bhi MCP server ko test aur debug karne ke liye banaye gaye UI ko power karta hai, jise woh connect kar sakta hai. MCP Inspector MCP spec ki har client aur server feature ko support karta hai, jisse koi bhi MCP server test kiya ja sakta hai, jiska access ho. Yeh tumhare local server se connect karke kaam karta hai aur ek UI deta hai, jo alag-alag MCP messages ke results display kar sakta hai, jaise tools/list, tools/call, prompts/list waghera. Iska matlab hai ki server ke saath woh sab kuch kiya ja sakta hai, jo koi connected agent ya host application kar sakti hai — auth flows test karna, prompts load karke dekhna, notifications ko aate hi inspect karna, OAuth flows debug karna, aur bahut kuch. Lekin yeh narrowly focused hai — server ko seedha test karne par, taaki woh apna kaam sahi se kare. Agar kuch aisa chahiye jo MCP servers ko zyada end-to-end fashion me test kare, alag-alag LLMs ke against, to ek zyada broad-based tool chahiye hoga. MCPJam un tools me se ek hai.

MCPJam ka approach thoda alag hai: isme ek standalone inspector hai, jo MCP Inspector jaisa kaam karta hai, lekin iska focus test kiye jaa rahe server ko ek ya zyada models se ek saath connect karna hai, taaki actual models se interact karke server ko zyada realistic setting me test kiya ja sake. UI me chat khud dikh sakti hai, model aur user ke beech bheje gaye messages ke traces, saath me connected servers, ya full JSON payloads. Isme built-in inspector interface bhi hai, to tools, prompts aur bahut kuch manually trigger kiye ja sakte hain. Debugging ke liye yeh major help hai, lekin models ko side by side compare karne ki ability ise transform kar deti hai. MCPJam me ek OAuth debugger bhi hai, jo OAuth ki conformance test kar sakta hai, jaise woh alag-alag protocol versions me support hota hai, aur saare OAuth steps se walkthrough karwa sakta hai. UI ke alawa MCPJam ka ek CLI tool bhi hai, jise pasand ka agent use kar sakta hai. Is tool me UI wale features hi hain, bas agents ke saath interaction ke liye optimize kiye gaye hain.

← Previous09 · Tools to help you build — MCP Registry→ Next09.2 · MCP Extensions — Apps, Auth, Tasks
09.2Chapter 9 · Wrapping Up: Tools to Help You Build, MCP Extensions, and Contributing to MCP

MCP Extensions — Apps, Auth, Tasks

Core protocol ke bahar bhi MCP badh raha hai — extensions se. MCP Apps servers ko apna UI dene deti hain, Auth extensions machine-to-machine aur enterprise authorization cover karte hain, aur Tasks asynchronous tool execution enable karta hai.

Extensions kya hain

MCP extensions MCP Apps aur MCP Auth Extensions ke introduction se shuru hue, jo 2025-11-25 MCP specification release me aaye, aur extensions ke liye ek formalized framework 2026-07-28 release candidate ke saath aaya. MCP extensions protocol ko nayi features se extend karne ka ek tareeqa hain, jo core protocol ka hissa nahi hain, lekin phir bhi developers ke liye useful ho sakti hain, aur core protocol se independently develop hoti hain. Inhe protocol me ek special identifier milta hai, vendor ID/extension name ke form me, jahan vendor ID ek string hai jo extension ke vendor ko identify karti hai (aur strongly suggest kiya jaata hai ki yeh reverse domain name ho), aur extension name ek string hai jo extension ko identify karta hai, jaise MCP Apps ke liye io.modelcontextprotocol/ui. MCP ke currently chaar official extensions hain: MCP Apps, MCP OAuth Client Credentials aur Enterprise-Managed Authorization (yeh dono MCP Auth Extensions ke umbrella ke under group hain), aur MCP Tasks.

MCP Apps — server ka apna UI

MCP Apps ek independent project ke roop me shuru hue, jise MCP-UI kaha gaya tha, jo MCP par UI components deliver karne ke liye banaya gaya tha. MCP-UI ko specification me ek extension ke roop me integrate kiya gaya, jo server-based tools ko apne UIs define karne me madad karta hai, aur users ko server ke saath command line se zyada visual tareeqe se interact karne deta hai. MCP Apps tool aur resource primitives ko combine karte hain — tool description me ek naya field aata hai, _meta.ui.resourceUri, jo us resource ki taraf point karta hai jisme UI khud hai. Yeh aam taur par HTML, CSS aur JavaScript ka ek bundle hota hai, jo web browser me render ho sakta hai, lekin tools _meta.ui.csp field me external resources bhi define kar sakte hain. MCP Apps ko protocol me extension ke roop me integrate kiya gaya, kyunki yeh core protocol ke scope se bahar baithte hain aur client/server communication ke liye thoda modified JSON-RPC protocol use karte hain. Kyunki extension tools aur resources ke upar bana hai, yeh existing MCP messages aur capabilities use karta hai, jaise server se interact karne ke liye tools/call, aur naye message types bhi, jo ui/ se prefixed hote hain. Actual apps ek sandboxed iframe me chalte hain, jo rogue app ko host application ya user data access karne se rokta hai. MCP Apps ke kai use cases hain, jaise MCP server se expose kiye gaye data ko visualize karna, MCP resources se video display karna, ya locally available data se reports banana. Zyada details full MCP Apps documentation me milti hain.

MCP Auth Extensions

MCP apne authorization extension specifications ko ek single repository me group karta hai: ext-auth. Yahan authorization extensions ke liye governance rules ke saath-saath existing extensions ki specifications milti hain: OAuth Client Credentials aur Enterprise-Managed Authorization. Agar tumhara server typical interactive OAuth user authorization kar raha hai to in extensions ki zaroorat nahi hogi. Iske bajay yeh kam common authorization use cases cover karne ke liye hain, jaise machine-to-machine auth (OAuth Client Credentials) ya internal enterprise-wide auth (Enterprise-Managed Authorization).

OAuth Client Credentials support karna useful hai jab machines ke beech authorization provide karni ho, jahan traditional interactive OAuth flow kaam nahi karega. Ek client application credentials (jaise client ID aur secret) use karke seedha authorization server se authorize kar sakta hai, jo phir seedha client ko access token de sakta hai. Client phir us bearer token ke saath server ko MCP request karta hai, aur dikhata hai ki woh us server ko access karne ke liye authorized hai. Python SDK OAuth Client Credentials extension ka implementation deta hai, ClientCredentialsOAuthProvider, jo seedha use kiya ja sakta hai. Kyunki yeh ek httpx2.Auth object hai, use httpx2.AsyncClient(auth=...) se attach kiya jaata hai, phir woh HTTP client transport ko uske http_client parameter se de diya jaata hai. Is likhai ke waqt major MCP clients me se koi bhi auth extensions ko support nahi karta, sirf Archestra Enterprise-Managed Authorization support karta hai.

Enterprise-Managed Authorization, dusri taraf, enterprises ko apne preferred identity provider (jaise Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, ya Amazon Cognito) ko stand-in ke roop me use karne deta hai, employees ke dwara use kiye jaane wale MCP clients aur authorization chahne wale MCP servers ke beech. Isse client software users ko har MCP server ke liye authorize karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti, jise woh use kar rahe hain. Iske liye zaroori hai ki organization me use hone wale clients extension ke liye apna support capabilities object ke extensions field me declare karein, SSO support karein taaki users apne identity provider me log in kar sakein (aur resulting identity assertion save kar sakein), saved identity assertion use karke identity provider se ID-JAG token retrieve kar sakein, organizations ko saare users ke liye configurations set karne dein (per-user settings ko override karke), aur of course, token scopes aur scope errors ko gracefully handle karein.

MCP Tasks — asynchronous tool execution

MCP Tasks extension MCP servers ke liye asynchronous tool execution support karta hai. Tool call ke execution block karne ke bajay, MCP Tasks se server CreateTaskResult object return kar sakta hai, jisme taskId hota hai, jise client phir task ke status ke liye server ko poll karne ke liye use kar sakta hai. MCP Tasks isliye exist karta hai kyunki ek stateless transport request ko khula nahi rakh sakta aur host application par execution block nahi kar sakta, jab ek slow job chal raha ho. Isliye client ek tool call kar sakta hai aur (currently, sirf tools/call) turant CreateTaskResult placeholder result pa sakta hai, jisme task ka taskId hota hai. Jab tak task par kaam ho raha hai, client apne dusre kaam ke saath aage badh sakta hai, aur tasks/get message bhejkar task ke taskId ke saath server ko periodically poll kar sakta hai. Yeh GetTaskResult object return karega, jisme task ka status hota hai.

Yeh asynchronous task kickoff workflow external job APIs ke typical design se bahut achhe se map hota hai, jo MCP Tasks ko bilkul usi type ke operation ke liye well suited banata hai: CI/CD run kick off karna, bada data download, model training run, ya batch computation job, kuch examples ke liye. Ek task ek durable state machine hai. Yeh working se shuru hota hai aur teen states me se ek me khatam ho sakta hai: completed, failed, ya cancelled. Working rehte hue yeh input_required me aa-ja sakta hai, jo task ki execution ko pause kar deta hai, jab tak client server ko woh jaankari return na kare jo use working state me wapas jaane ke liye chahiye. Jab task complete ho jaata hai to GetTaskResult me final result ke saath result field hoti hai. Task ke valid statuses hain: working — task abhi bhi execute ho raha hai; input_required — server ko user input chahiye aur woh mile bina continue nahi kar sakta; completed — task successfully complete ho gaya; failed — task unsuccessfully complete hua; cancelled — task client ne cancel kar diya.

Kyunki task state server par taskId se keyed hokar rehti hai, isme se kuch bhi ek single connection ke khule rehne par depend nahi karta. Ek client, jab tak woh apne task IDs ko kahin durable store karta hai — database me, append-only log me, disk par, waghera — uska task interrupt nahi hoga, agar woh reboot kare, crash ho, naye network par move kare, ya wider internet se uska connection disrupt ho, kyunki maintain karne ke liye koi specific connection nahi hai. Jab client recover karta hai to woh results ke liye polling jaari rakh sakta hai. Ek note: is likhai ke waqt Python SDK Tasks extension ko support nahi karta, lekin yeh roadmap ka hissa hai, to yeh overview protocol level par hi rehta hai.

SOURCESource: AI Agents with MCP, O'Reilly, Chapter 9 — Wrapping Up: Tools to Help You Build, MCP Extensions, and Contributing to MCP

09.3Chapter 9 · Wrapping Up: Tools to Help You Build, MCP Extensions, and Contributing to MCP

MCP me contribute karna aur aage ka raasta

MCP 2024 ke aakhir me ek side project ke roop me shuru hua tha, aur aaj Agentic AI Foundation ka hissa hai, jisme specification contribute karne ka ek clear pipeline aur process hai. Aage ka raasta bhi utna hi exciting hai.

Specification Enhancement Proposal — SEP

MCP me contribute karna saalon me zyada straightforward ho gaya hai. Pehle MCP late 2024 me ek side project ke roop me aaya tha, jisme governance guidance kam thi, lekin aaj MCP Agentic AI Foundation ka hissa hai aur isme ek clear specification contribution pipeline aur process hai. Protocol me change propose karne ka main vehicle hai Specification Enhancement Proposal (SEP) ko MCP GitHub repository me pull request ke roop me submit karna. Ek achha SEP well researched hota hai, ideally MCP Contributor Discord me related working groups ke saath discuss kiya gaya hota hai, ek aisa issue address karta hai jo dusre MCP users bhi experience karte hain, aur MCP design principles ke saath align hota hai.

Chhote changes, jaise documentation changes ya bug fixes, ke liye SEP draft karna zaroori nahi hai. Iske bajay SEPs ko existing protocol features add, change ya remove karne; protocol me breaking changes (jaise sampling ka deprecation); ya contribution guidelines jaise governance-related items me changes ke liye address karna chahiye. SEPs sirf protocol spec tak restricted hain aur SDKs ya extensions jaise implementations me use nahi hote.

Apna idea validate karne ke baad SEP likhna shuru kar sakte ho. Yeh bhi consider karna chahiye ki tumhara SEP kis track ka hissa hoga. Standards track nayi MCP features ya MCP feature set me changes ke liye use hota hai — yeh woh track hai jisme zyada tar SEPs aayenge. SEP-2575, jo MCP ko by default stateless banata hai, ek achha example hai. Informational track un SEPs ke liye hai jo users aur maintainers ke liye guidelines dete hain, jo requirements nahi hain — yeh rare hain; likhai ke waqt is track par ek bhi accepted SEP nahi mila tha. Process track governance ya MCP ke aas-paas ki kisi bhi process me proposed changes ke liye use hota hai, aur existing processes describe karne ke liye bhi — SEP-2149 ek example hai. Extensions track un SEPs ke liye hai jo naye extensions propose karte hain ya existing extensions me changes karte hain.

Kis track ka SEP hai, yeh jaanna important hai, kyunki yeh SEP ki journey ko influence karta hai. Khaas taur par Standards aur Extensions tracks ke SEPs ko approval se pehle conformance testing se guzarna hota hai aur ek prototype implementation banana hota hai. Track koi bhi ho, SEPs ek standard format follow karte hain. Pehle, proposed SEP ko MCP repository ke sep directory me ek Markdown file ke roop me likha jaana chahiye, aur 0000 se prefixed hona chahiye. File me yeh sections hone chahiye: SEP ke baare me metadata wala preamble (title, authors, SEP type, waghera), ek abstract jo batata hai ki SEP kya address karta hai, ek motivation jo current protocol ki shortcomings explain karta hai, specification jo nayi feature ko detail me describe karta hai, ek rationale jo batata hai ki yeh approach kyun li gayi aur dusri approaches kya consider ki gayi thi, ek backward-compatibility section jo batata hai ki koi backward incompatibilities introduce hui hain aur unse kaise deal karna hai, ek reference implementation, aur SEP ke liye security implications par ek section. Repository me ek SEP template hai, jo apna SEP likhne me madad kar sakta hai.

SEP ki journey — draft se final tak

Research kar li, SEP likh liya, aur MCP repository ko pull request submit kar diya — SEP ki journey abhi shuru hui hai. PR banane ke baad SEP file ke placeholder prefix number ko PR number se update kar sakte ho, aur phir ek sponsor dhoondhna hota hai, jo SEP ko process se shepherd kare. Yeh ek maintainer hona chahiye, jiske area of responsibility ke under SEP aata ho ya kam se kam usse related ho. Unhe PR me tag kiya ja sakta hai ya Discord me sponsor ke liye poocha ja sakta hai. Jab sponsor khud ko GitHub me PR par assign karta hai, to woh SEP status ko draft par update karega, aur SEP ke review ke kai rounds honge. Initial round informal hota hai, sponsor ke dwara chalaya jaata hai, aur PR me hi hota hai. Formal review round me sponsor SEP status ko in-review par update karega, aur core maintainers apni regular meetings me discuss karenge. Uske baad SEP ko ya to accepted ya rejected status me daala jaata hai, ya aur revisions ke liye wapas bhej diya jaata hai. Jab SEP accept ho jaata hai, to reference implementation banana tumhari responsibility hoti hai, aur agar Standards ya Extension track ka SEP complete kar rahe ho to MCP conformance repository me conformance test add karna hota hai. Isse SDK, server aur client developers apne code ko repeatable tareeqe se spec ke against test kar sakte hain. Jab yeh ho jaata hai to sponsor SEP status ko final par update karega, aur use future release me aane ke liye schedule kar diya jayega.

Contribute karne ke dusre tareeqe

Of course, MCP me contribute karne ka yeh ekmatra tareeqa nahi hai. Official SDKs dusre Git-based open source projects ki tarah issue reports aur PRs lete hain, aur official documentation bhi. Agar kisi bhi tareeqe se MCP project me contribute karna chahte ho to developer ka Discord shuru karne ke liye ek excellent jagah hai, aur Working and Interest Groups page un focus areas ko dhoondhne me madad kar sakta hai, jo tumhare interests se line up hote hain.

Aage kya hai — MCP ka future

MCP tezi se move kar raha hai. Book likhne ke dauran teen specification releases, kai SDK updates, aur Python SDK ka kam se kam ek (abhi tak incomplete) major update dekha gaya. Keep up karna overwhelming ho sakta hai, to horizon par kya hai, yeh jaanna madad karta hai — taaki wahan skate kiya ja sake jahan puck jaa raha hai. Ek experimental effort jis par nazar rakhni chahiye, woh hai Skills Over MCP (SEP-2640, working group charter), jo tool delivery se aage jaakar servers ko tools use aur orchestrate karne ka know-how share karne ki kalpana karta hai, unhe ek goal ke liye combine karke. Agent skills ne apni simplicity aur power se software duniya me dhoom macha di hai; yeh samajh me aata hai ki woh MCP servers se distributable hone chahiye. Proposal skills ko MCP ke existing resource primitive par serve karne ke tareeqe explore karta hai, jisse unhe dynamic discovery aur updates ka benefit milta hai.

MCP roadmap page ek great tareeqa hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki maintainers cheezon ko kis direction me push karna chahte hain. Isme kai priority areas aur unke andar ke goals list hote hain. Currently woh hain: transport evolution aur security, agent communication, governance maturation, aur enterprise readiness. In areas se related SEPs ko prioritized review milne ki ummeed ki ja sakti hai, aur accepted SEPs ko SDKs aur third-party software me faster implementation ki ummeed ki ja sakti hai. Iske alawa in areas me aam taur par ek ya do working groups hain, jo improvements develop kar rahe hain. Lower-priority areas, jinme phir bhi widespread interest dikha hai, me event-driven updates provide karna, results ko improve karna taaki unhe stream karna ya clients ko decide karne dena possible ho ki unhe context me load karna hai ya nahi, authorization improvements karna, aur nascent ecosystem ko mature karna shamil hain. Agar kaafi waqt aur interest dikha to inke liye working groups banaye ja sakte hain. Shayad tum unme se ek ke founding working group members me se ek ban sakte ho.

Aur iske saath MCP ki journey complete bhi hai aur abhi shuru bhi hui hai. Protocol khud me aur khaas taur par Python me uski implementation me ek strong foundation bana li hai. Clients, servers aur transports likhna shuru karne ke liye zaroorat se zyada sab kuch mil gaya hai. Iske alawa hard-won knowledge bhi mili hai, jo immensely madad karegi, agar protocol ya Python SDK me contribute karne ka faisla karo. Ab aage badho aur banao.

SOURCESource: AI Agents with MCP, O'Reilly, Chapter 9 — Wrapping Up: Tools to Help You Build, MCP Extensions, and Contributing to MCP

F1End Matter · Interview FAQs
Interview FAQs
MCP interviews (current era) ke liye — protocol se lekar transports aur security tak, 36 sawaal-jawaab. Har jawaab isi book ke concepts par aadharit hai.
Q01 MCP kya hai?
MCP matlab Model Context Protocol, ek open protocol hai jo LLM based applications ko tools, prompts aur data resources se ek standard tareeke se connect karta hai. Isse pehle har model ke liye har tool ka alag connector likhna padta tha, jo bahut mehnat aur bug ka kaam tha. MCP ek common interface deta hai, jisse koi bhi MCP supporting model kisi bhi MCP server se jud sakta hai. Ye protocol Anthropic ne shuru kiya tha aur aaj ye ek open standard ki tarah grow kar raha hai.
Q02 MCP kyun zaroori hai, bina MCP ke kya problem thi?
Bina MCP ke har LLM ko har tool ya data source se jodne ke liye alag alag connector likhna padta tha, jise M x N problem kehte hain. Jaise 3 models aur 4 tools ho to 12 connectors likhne padte the, jo largely ek jaisa code repeat karte the. Isse bugs aane ke chance badh jate the aur naye model ya naye tool ko jodna bahut mehenga ho jata tha. MCP ek hi standard interface dekar is problem ko M + N me badal deta hai, jisse scaling bahut aasan ho jati hai.
Q03 MCP aur normal REST API me kya farak hai?
REST API me fixed endpoints hote hain aur developer ko pehle se pata hota hai kaunsa endpoint kab call karna hai, jabki MCP me LLM khud decide karta hai kaunsa tool kab use karna hai. MCP me client pehle server se ListTools jaise calls se available tools discover karta hai, phir model unme se choose karke CallTool se unhe chalata hai. MCP sirf tools hi nahi, prompts aur resources bhi ek hi standard interface se deta hai. Isliye MCP LLM centric hai, jabki REST API developer centric hoti hai.
Q04 MCP architecture ke main components kaunse hain?
MCP architecture ke chaar main components hain: host, client, server aur transport. Host wo application hai jisme LLM chalta hai aur user interact karta hai, jaise Claude Desktop ya koi coding assistant. Client host aur server ke beech ka connector hai, server tools, prompts aur resources provide karta hai, aur transport wo layer hai jo client aur server ke beech messages pahunchata hai. Ye chaaro milkar ek standard tareeka banate hain jisse koi bhi model kisi bhi server se jud sakta hai.
Q05 Host application kya karta hai?
Host wo application hai jahan user kaam karta hai aur jahan LLM chalta hai, jaise ek AI coding assistant ya chat application. Host ek ya zyada MCP clients ko manage karta hai aur unke through alag alag servers se connect karta hai. Host LLM ko tools available karata hai, model ke tool calls ko client tak pahunchata hai, aur sampling aur elicitation jaise client capabilities bhi provide karta hai. Matlab host hi wo jagah hai jahan poora agentic experience user ko dikhta hai.
Q06 MCP client ka kaam kya hai?
MCP client host application aur MCP server ke beech ka connector hota hai. Client server se connection banata hai, phir initialize aur discovery ke through server ki capabilities aur available tools, prompts aur resources ka pata lagata hai. Jab LLM koi tool use karna chahta hai, to host client ko batata hai aur client CallTool message bhejkar server se wo tool chalwata hai. Client server ki taraf se aane wali requests, jaise sampling ya elicitation, ko bhi host tak pahunchata hai.
Q07 MCP server kya provide karta hai?
MCP server host application ko capabilities provide karta hai, jinme tools, prompts aur resources main hain. Tools wo actions hain jo LLM chala sakta hai, jaise file padhna, database query karna ya koi API call karna. Prompts reusable templates hote hain jo structured instructions dete hain, aur resources wo data hote hain jo LLM padh sakta hai, jaise files ya live records. Server in sab ko ek standard interface se expose karta hai, taaki koi bhi MCP client inhe use kar sake.
Q08 MCP me JSON-RPC kyun use hota hai?
JSON-RPC ek lightweight message format hai jisme har message ek request, response ya notification hota hai. MCP ke saare messages, chahe wo tool call ho ya capability discovery, JSON-RPC format me hi bheje jate hain. Ye format simple aur language independent hai, isliye Python, TypeScript ya kisi bhi language ka client ya server ise use kar sakta hai. MCP ko ye idea Language Server Protocol se mila, jo IDE aur language servers ke beech bhi JSON-RPC hi use karta hai.
Q09 MCP connection lifecycle kya hai?
MCP connection lifecycle ke main phases hain: initialize, operation aur shutdown. Pehle client server ko initialize message bhejta hai, jisme dono apni capabilities aur protocol version exchange karte hain. Uske baad operation phase me client tools list karta hai, tools call karta hai, prompts aur resources use karta hai. Ant me connection ko cleanly band kar diya jata hai, taaki server resources free kar sake. Streamable HTTP jaise transports me lifecycle thoda alag ho sakta hai, lekin basic phases wahi rehte hain.
Q10 Capability negotiation aur discovery kaise kaam karti hai?
Connection ke shuru me client aur server initialize ke dauraan apni apni capabilities exchange karte hain, jaise client sampling support karta hai ya server tools deta hai. Uske baad client ListTools, ListPrompts aur ListResources jaise calls se server par available cheezein discover karta hai. Isse client ko pehle se pata chal jata hai ki server kya kar sakta hai aur kya nahi. Ye discovery step bahut zaroori hai, kyunki bina iske LLM ko pata hi nahi chalega ki use kaunse tools mil sakte hain.
Q11 stdio transport kya hai aur kab use karna chahiye?
stdio transport local MCP servers ke liye use hota hai, jisme client server process ko khud launch karta hai. Client aur server ke beech messages standard input aur standard output se JSON-RPC format me aate jaate hain. Ye tareeka simple aur fast hai, aur local development aur desktop applications ke liye best hai. Lekin ye sirf usi machine par kaam karta hai jahan client chal raha hai, remote servers ke liye ye suitable nahi hai.
Q12 Streamable HTTP transport kya hai aur stdio se kab better hai?
Streamable HTTP transport remote MCP servers ke liye banaya gaya hai, jisme client HTTP par JSON-RPC messages bhejta hai. Isme stdio jaisa koi local process launch nahi hota, balki client ek URL se connect karta hai aur session based communication hoti hai. Jab server alag machine par ho, ya ek hi server ko bahut saare users use kar rahe hon, to Streamable HTTP sahi choice hai. Isme authentication bhi lagana padta hai, isliye ye stdio se zyada setup mangta hai.
Q13 Sampling kya hai?
Sampling ek client capability hai jisme MCP server host application ke LLM se chat completion maang sakta hai. Server khud LLM nahi chalata, balki client ko sampling request bhejta hai aur client apne model se jawab lekar wapas bhejta hai. Iska use tab hota hai jab server ke tool ko kisi decision ke liye LLM ki reasoning chahiye hoti hai. Ek important baat ye hai ki 2026-07-28 wale specification me sampling ko deprecate karne ki process shuru ho gayi hai, isliye is par depend karne se pehle latest spec check karni chahiye.
Q14 Roots kya hote hain?
Roots ek client capability hai jisme client server ko batata hai ki filesystem ke kin hisso tak server ki access honi chahiye. Jaise ek coding assistant sirf current project folder ko root ki tarah mark kar sakta hai, taaki server usi ke andar kaam kare. Lekin roots strictly enforce nahi hote, ye sirf ek hint hain aur server ko khud inhe respect karna padta hai. Sampling ki tarah roots bhi 2026-07-28 wale specification me deprecate hone ki process me hain.
Q15 Elicitation kya hai?
Elicitation ek client capability hai jisme server user se extra information maang sakta hai. Jaise agar koi tool chalane ke liye koi input missing hai, to server elicitation request bhejta hai aur host UI dikhakar user se wo input leta hai. Sampling se iska farak ye hai ki sampling LLM se jawab mangti hai, jabki elicitation seedha user se input leti hai. Isse agent beech me atke bina user se zaroori detail lekar kaam aage badha sakta hai.
Q16 MCP me OAuth 2.1 ka kya role hai?
OAuth 2.1 remote MCP servers ko secure karne ka standard tareeka hai. Jab client kisi remote server se connect karta hai, to wo OAuth flow se user ki taraf se ek access token leta hai. Har request ke saath ye token bheja jata hai aur server token verify karke decide karta hai ki user kaun hai aur use kya karne ki permission hai. Isse server bina apna password share kiye user ko limited aur revocable access de sakta hai.
Q17 Remote MCP server ko secure kaise karte hain?
Remote MCP server ko secure karne ke liye sabse pehle HTTPS use karna chahiye, taaki messages encrypt rahein. Uske baad OAuth tokens se har request par authentication aur authorization check karna chahiye, aur sirf zaroori scopes hi dene chahiye. Rate limiting aur logging bhi lagani chahiye, taaki misuse pakda ja sake. Bina authentication ke remote server kabhi public mat karo, kyunki koi bhi uske tools ko misuse kar sakta hai.
Q18 Kisi anjaan MCP server ko connect karne se pehle kya check karna chahiye?
Kisi bhi naye MCP server ko connect karne se pehle use vet karna bahut zaroori hai, kyunki server ko aapke data aur tools tak access milti hai. Pehle dekho ki server kisne banaya hai, uska code kya karta hai aur wo kaunse tools expose karta hai. Tool ke description me chhupi hui misleading instructions bhi ho sakti hain, jo LLM ko galat kaam karne par majboor kar dein. Sirf trusted servers connect karo aur sensitive data wale servers ko sandbox me chalao.
Q19 MCP tools kya hote hain?
Tools MCP ki sabse important primitive hain, ye wo actions hain jo LLM chala sakta hai. Har tool ka ek naam, ek clear description aur ek input schema hota hai, jo batata hai ki tool ko kaunse arguments chahiye. Jab user koi request karta hai, to LLM available tools me se sahi tool choose karta hai aur client CallTool se use server par chalata hai. Tool ka result phir LLM ko wapas milta hai, jisse wo apna jawab complete karta hai.
Q20 Prompts kya hote hain aur tools se kaise alag hain?
Prompts reusable templates hote hain jo user ya LLM ko structured instructions dete hain, jaise ek code review prompt ya ek data analysis prompt. Tools se inka farak ye hai ki tools koi action karte hain, jaise file likhna ya API call karna, jabki prompts sirf text ya instruction dete hain, koi side effect nahi karte. Prompts me arguments bhi ho sakte hain, jaise kisi specific file ya topic ka naam. Isse user baar baar wahi instruction type karne se bach jata hai.
Q21 Resources kya hote hain?
Resources wo data hote hain jo MCP server expose karta hai aur LLM padh sakta hai, jaise files, database records ya live application data. Har resource ko ek URI se identify kiya jata hai, aur client use read karke uska content LLM tak pahunchata hai. Tools se farak ye hai ki resources sirf data padhne ke liye hote hain, inhe call karke koi action nahi hoti. Resources se LLM ko context milta hai, jisse wo user ke sawal ka behtar jawab de sakta hai.
Q22 FastMCP aur high-level SDK kya hai?
FastMCP Python MCP SDK ka high-level tareeka hai, jisme aap decorators se bahut jaldi tools, prompts aur resources bana sakte hain. Aapko sirf ek function likhna hota hai aur decorator batata hai ki ye ek tool hai, baaki boilerplate SDK sambhal leta hai. Zyada tar MCP servers ke liye high-level SDK hi kaafi hota hai, kyunki ye code ko chhota aur readable banata hai. Ye framework MCP ko adopt karne ki sabse badi wajahon me se ek raha hai.
Q23 Low-level SDK kab use karna chahiye?
Low-level SDK tab use karna chahiye jab aapko protocol par fine-grained control chahiye ho. Jaise agar aapko custom lifecycle handling, custom message processing ya advanced client capabilities ko detail me implement karna hai, to high-level SDK kam pad sakta hai. Low-level SDK me aapko zyada code likhna padta hai, lekin har cheez par aapka control rehta hai. Simple servers ke liye high-level SDK hi behtar hai, low-level sirf special cases ke liye hai.
Q24 Transport kya hota hai MCP me?
Transport wo layer hai jo MCP client aur server ke beech messages ko ek jagah se doosri jagah pahunchata hai. Messages hamesha JSON-RPC format me hote hain, transport sirf unhe le jaane ka tareeka badalta hai. MCP ke do default transports hain: local connections ke liye stdio aur remote connections ke liye Streamable HTTP. Transport choose karte waqt ye dekhna hota hai ki server local hai ya remote, aur security ki kya zaroorat hai.
Q25 Streamable HTTP me sessions kaise kaam karte hain?
Streamable HTTP me communication session based hoti hai, matlab client pehle initialize karke ek session banata hai. Server us session ko ek session id deta hai, aur uske baad ke saare messages usi session ke context me aate jaate hain. Isse server ko pata rehta hai ki kaunsa client kaunsi state me hai, aur lambi baatchit me context bana rehta hai. Agar session toot jaye ya server restart ho jaye, to client ko dobara initialize karke naya session banana padta hai.
Q26 Apne server ke liye transport kaise choose karein?
Transport choose karte waqt sabse pehle ye dekho ki server kahan chalega aur kaun use karega. Agar server local machine par chalega aur sirf ek user ke liye hai, to stdio simple aur safe choice hai. Agar server remote hoga aur bahut saare users use karenge, to Streamable HTTP lena chahiye, saath me OAuth jaise authentication ke saath. Bahut se servers dono transports support karte hain, taaki local development aur remote deployment dono aasan rahein.
Q27 MCP server ko test kaise karte hain?
MCP server ko test karna kisi bhi software ko test karne jaisa hi hai: unit testing, integration testing aur end-to-end testing sab lagte hain. Unit tests individual functions ko check karte hain, integration tests external systems ke saath interaction ko check karte hain. Iske alawa MCP Inspector ek bahut kaam ka tool hai, jo ek fully-featured client ki tarah behave karke aapke server ko manually test karne deta hai. Inspector se aap tools call kar sakte ho, logs aur notifications dekh sakte ho, aur message passing ko inspect kar sakte ho.
Q28 Evaluations kya hain aur testing se kaise alag hain?
Evaluations me pehle se tay user prompts par model ke behaviour ko measure kiya jata hai, jaise sahi tool choose hua ya nahi, sahi arguments gaye ya nahi, aur guardrails sahi kaam kiye ya nahi. Testing code ki correctness ko check karti hai, jabki evaluations model ke behaviour ko expected outcomes se compare karti hain. MCP servers ke liye evaluations khaas taur par zaroori hain, kyunki tool ka naam aur description hi decide karte hain ki model use kab aur kaise choose karega. Achhi evaluations se pata chalta hai ki server real users ke saamne kaisa behave karega.
Q29 MCP Registry kya hai?
MCP Registry ek official jagah hai jahan MCP servers ko discover aur list kiya ja sakta hai. Registry me har server ki metadata hoti hai, jaise uska naam, version, description aur capabilities. Clients aur users registry se apni zaroorat ka server dhoondh sakte hain, bina har server ko alag se khojne ke. Registry se ecosystem me trust aur discoverability badhti hai, kyunki users ko pata chalta hai ki kaunse servers available aur maintained hain.
Q30 MCP ecosystem me frameworks aur extensions ka kya role hai?
MCP ecosystem me frameworks, jaise FastMCP, server banana bahut aasan kar dete hain, jisse developers protocol ki detail me ghuse bina jaldi server bana sakte hain. Extensions protocol me nayi capabilities jodte hain, jinhe community propose aur test karti hai. MCP Inspector jaise tools development aur debugging me madad karte hain. Ye poora ecosystem hi MCP ki adoption ki wajah hai, kyunki akele protocol se zyada uske aas paas ke tools kaam aate hain.
Q31 M x N problem kya hai?
M x N problem wo situation hai jisme M models ko N tools se jodne ke liye M x N connectors likhne padte hain. Jaise 3 models aur 4 tools ho to 12 connectors likhne padenge, jo largely ek jaisa code repeat karte hain. MCP is problem ko M + N me badal deta hai, matlab 3 models aur 4 tools ke liye sirf 7 connectors chahiye hote hain. Ye farak chhote scale par chhota lagta hai, lekin jab models aur tools ki sankhya badhti hai to yehi farak scaling ko possible banata hai.
Q32 MCP ko Language Server Protocol se kya inspiration mili?
MCP ko Language Server Protocol, matlab LSP, se seedhi inspiration mili hai. LSP se pehle har IDE ko har programming language ke liye alag integration likhni padti thi, jo wahi M x N problem thi. LSP ne IDE aur language servers ke beech ek standard JSON-RPC interface banaya, jisse ek hi baar integration likhni padti thi. MCP ne wahi idea LLM aur tools par lagaya: ek common interface, JSON-RPC messages, aur host, client aur server jaisi architecture. Isliye LSP ko samajhna MCP architecture ko samajhne ka sabse aasan tareeka hai.
Q33 Confused deputy problem MCP me kya hai?
Confused deputy problem tab hoti hai jab agent kisi trusted party ki authority ka galat use karke aisi action kar deta hai jo user ne nahi chahi thi. MCP me ye is tarah hota hai: koi tool ya resource ka output me chhupa hua instruction agent ko sensitive action karne par majboor kar de, jaise koi file delete karna ya private data bhej dena. Agent ko lagta hai ki wo user ki madad kar raha hai, lekin asal me wo untrusted content ke instructions follow kar raha hota hai. Isse bachne ke liye tool outputs ko hamesha data samjho, instruction nahi, aur sensitive actions se pehle user se confirmation lo.
Q34 Lethal trifecta kya hai?
Lethal trifecta wo dangerous combination hai jab ek hi agent ke paas teeno cheezein ek saath hon: private data ki access, bahar communicate karne ki capability, aur untrusted content ko padhne ki ability. Akele me inme se koi bhi itni khatarnak nahi hai, lekin teeno milkar prompt injection se data leak ka rasta khol deti hain. Jaise agent aapki private file padhe, usme chhupa hua instruction follow kare, aur data ko bahar bhej de. Isliye in teeno ko ek saath bina guardrails ke kabhi mat jodo, aur sensitive data wale tools ko alag rakho.
Q35 Bahut saare tools hone se kya problem hoti hai aur tool search kya hai?
Jab model ko ek saath bahut saare tools dikhaye jate hain, to wo confuse ho jata hai aur galat tool choose karne lagta hai. Iske alawa har tool ka description context window me jagah leta hai, jisse token cost badhti hai aur asli kaam ke liye jagah kam bachti hai. Is problem ka solution tool-list optimization hai, jisme sirf relevant tools hi model ko dikhaye jate hain. Tool search iska ek tareeka hai, jisme server ya client user ki query ke hisaab se tools ko filter karke sirf matching tools hi model tak pahunchata hai.
Q36 Context engineering kya hai?
Context engineering wo kala hai jisme model ke context window ko carefully manage kiya jata hai, taaki model ko sahi cheezein sahi matra me milen. Zyada context dene se model bhatak jata hai aur galat tools ya galat data par focus karne lagta hai, jabki kam context dene se wo kaam hi nahi kar pata. MCP me context engineering ka matlab hai tool list, resources aur prompts ko soch samajhkar choose karna, taaki model ko sirf wahi dikhe jo us task ke liye zaroori hai. Achha context engineering hi ek reliable agent aur ek unreliable agent ke beech ka farak banata hai.
